eyebrow: Cross-Platform Relational Database Administration · Chapter Fourteen
subtitle: Lesson 70 · PostgreSQL Backup & Recovery

code:
-Fp   plain SQL, restore with psql
-Fc   custom (compressed), restore with pg_restore
-Ft   tar archive
-Fd   directory, parallel dump AND restore

pg_dump -Fc -d salesdb -f salesdb.dump
pg_restore -d salesdb_new -j 4 salesdb.dump
caption: Custom format (-Fc) is the production default: parallel, selective, pg_restore-driven.

code:
pg_dumpall --globals-only -f globals.sql

Restore order:
  1. recreate cluster
  2. restore globals.sql (roles, tablespaces)
  3. restore each database (pg_restore)
caption: pg_dump never touches roles or tablespaces — pg_dumpall fills that gap.

subtitle: A full physical copy of the cluster, streamed live.
